MINUTES
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  DECEMBER 16, 2019

  The Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order at 7:03
  p.m. at City Council Chambers 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California
  by CHAIR RETZ.

  1.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  CHAIR RETZ led those present in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  2.  ROLL CALL

  COMMISSIONERS PRESENT:  Retz, Persichina, Romanelli, Pope, Ciarolla, & Bain

  COMMISSIONERS ABSENT:  McCormick

  STAFF PRESENT:  Alexa Davis, Assistant City Manager
  Mike Goldsmith, Maintenance Superintendent
  Cynthia Morquecho, Comm. Services Supervisor
  Daniel A-Haja, Comm. Services Coordinator

  3.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES OF NOVEMBER 18, 2019

  COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  CIAROLLA to:

  APPROVE THE PARKS AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF
  NOVEMBER 18, 2019.

  There being no objection, CHAIR RETZ so ordered.

  4.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  None

  5.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  PROPOSED SPECIAL EVENT PERMIT MUNICIPAL CODE

  Community Services Supervisor Morquecho provided a brief overview per the agenda
  material.

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI asked if this permit would replace the current permits or
  if they would be in addition to the permit process already in place. Community Services
  Supervisor Morquecho stated it would streamline the permit process and would be in

DRAFT PARK AND ATIVITIES MEETING MINUTES  1
DECEMBER 16, 2019
   addition to the current permits under special events zoning. Assistant City Manager Davis
  stated this would replace the temporary use permit code under the Planning Department.

  COMMISSIONER BAIN asked in what way this would change the responsibilities of the
  Commission. Supervisor Morquecho responded that this would not change the
  responsibilities of the Commission as new special events will still be taken to the
  Commission for review. Assistant City Manager (ACM) Davis added that the process
  would provide further standards than what a park permit provides for special events with
  larger numbers. ACM Davis added that the current Temporary Use Permit by the Planning
  Department only covers commercial property and not City property.

  COMMISSIONER BAIN asked if it would facilitate or complicate the process of applying
  for a special event. Supervisor Morquecho replied that it would streamline the process as
  it will also help applicants find out which departments to go through for processing their
  events.

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI express concern about complicating a process that may
  be working well. ACM Davis responded that the process does not provide any significant
  differences from current process.

  COMMISSIONER POPE made a motion to accept staff recommendation. Commissioner
  Bain seconded.

  CHAIR RETZ REQUESTED A ROLL CALL VOTE:

  AYES:  Ciarolla, Bain, Persichina, Retz, Pope, & Romanelli
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  McCormick

  There being no objection, CHAIR RETZ so ordered.

  B.  PROPOSED REVISIONS TO PARK USE REGULATIONS

  Community Services Coordinator A-Haja provided a brief overview per the agenda
  material.

  CHAIR RETZ noted that the tennis wall is a wall structure which may be considered a park
  structure and that language should clarify the definition of what a wall is. ACM Davis
  added that language can be clarified.

  CHAIR RETZ noticed the equine portion did not cover donkeys or goats. Coordinator A-
  Haja noted the term “livestock” may be a more suitable alternative.

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI stated that this was the third time the Regulations were
  brought to the Commission for review and suggested that CHAIR RETZ’s revisions should
  be given to staff to be incorporated as to not prolong the process of approval of regulations.

DRAFT PARK AND ATIVITIES MEETING MINUTES  2
DECEMBER 16, 2019
   CHAIR RETZ asked that the firearms portion include cross bows and paintball guns. He
  also noted that any loophole in the regulation which allows the firing of blanks in the park
  should be looked at, stemming from the live shooting event proposed last summer.

  COMMISSIONER BAIN asked why the 90-day limit for permits was added to the
  regulations. Coordinator A-Haja noted that it was for staff to able to cash or return deposit
  checks timely. ACM Davis added that the 90 policy is a management tool for park picnics
  reservations and not the larger events.

  CHAIR RETZ will provide recommended wording revisions to staff to be incorporated and
  reviewed for a final time by the Commission.

  C.  2020 COMMITTEE AND SUBCOMMITTEE ASSIGNMENTS

  Community Services Coordinator A-Haja provided a brief overview per the agenda
  material.

  All assignments have remained the same except for CHAIR RETZ stepping down from
  the Environmental Advisory Committee to be replaced by COMMISSIONER BAIN.

  Assignments are as follows:

  2020 Standing Committee Representatives

  Equestrian Committee (Monthly as needed)…………………………………………...Ciarolla
  Traffic and Safety Committee (Quarterly as needed)………………………………….Pope
  Environmental Advisory Committee (Quarterly as needed)…………………………..Bain

  2020 Commission Subcommittee Members

  Tracy Austin Doubles Tennis Tournament Subcommittee……………………………Romanelli, Pope,
  McCormick
  The Hills Are Alive Race Subcommittee………………………………………………...Persichina, Ciarolla,
  Romanelli
  City Celebration Subcommittee…………………………………………………………..Pope, Retz, Ciarolla
  Peninsula Holiday Parade of Lights Subcommittee……………………………………Pope, Persichina,
  McCormick
  Youth Sports Subcommittee………………………………………………………………Persichina, Romanelli, Bain

  2020 Adopt-A-Park Assignments

  Ernie Howlett Park…………………………………………………………………………Persichina
  Highridge Park……………………………………………………………………………..Bain
  Rockbluff Park……………………………………………………………………………..Romanelli
  Chandler & Pepperwood Parks………………………………………………………….Ciarolla
  Silver Spur Park……………………………………………………………………………Pope
  Dapplegray & Butcher Parks……………………………………………………………..Retz
DRAFT PARK AND ATIVITIES MEETING MINUTES  3
DECEMBER 16, 2019
   George F Canyon Nature Center, Preserve & Taber Grove………………………….McCormick

  6.  AUDJOURN TO PEPPER TREE FOUNDATON ADVISORY BOARD MEETING

  A.  PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION SPONSORSHIP PROGRAM

  Community Services Supervisor Morquecho provided a brief overview per the agenda
  material.

  CHAIR RETZ recommended that the process to recruit sponsors should start after the first
  year in 2020 once this packet is approved and then thereafter in the last quarter of this
  year to meet other companies’ budgetary deadlines.

  COMMISSIONER POPE recommended to maintain a $1,000 dollar tier along with the new
  tiers, and to be prudent with benefits allowing for greater return with increasing investment.
  She additionally encouraged adding a page describing the City’s reach through its various
  media channels.

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI noted that some events like the City Celebration do not
  have expectations on recouping costs. Supervisor Morquecho affirmed and noted that
  some events were just for the benefit of the City but that fundraiser events such as the
  Tracy Austin Tournament help to enhance Pepper Tree Foundation funds.
  COMMISSIONER POPE recommends a clarifying statement in the report that is brought
  to the City Council.

  COMMISSIONER BAIN made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER POPE to:

  RECOMMEND THE ADOPTION OF THE 2020 SPONSORSHIP PACKAGE WITH
  THE AMENDMENTS OF INCLUDING THE $1,000 TIER AND INTITIATING THE
  PACKET IN THE FINAL QUARTER OF EVERY YEAR.

  CHAIR RETZ REQUESTED A ROLL CALL VOTE:

  AYES:  Ciarolla, Bain, Persichina, Retz, Pope, & Romanelli
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  McCormick

  There being no objection, CHAIR RETZ so ordered.

  ACM Davis commended Supervisor Morquecho on her work on the packets;
  Commissioners affirmed.

  7.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  A.  ADOPT-A-PARK REPORTS (VERBAL REPORT)

  CHAIR RETZ noted the City sign on Palos Verdes Drive North coming from Palos Verdes
  Estates needs to be redone. ACM Davis noted that all signs are being assessed.

DRAFT PARK AND ATIVITIES MEETING MINUTES  4
DECEMBER 16, 2019
   B.  YOUTH SPORTS SUBSOMMITTEE- SILVER SPUR LITTLE LEAGUE (VERBAL
  REPORT)

  COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA stated the league accepted the revised five-year
  agreement from the City and that participant numbers would be down this year but will still
  be going on.

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI stated that the League was interested in changing
  location of the proposed drinking fountain for the back stop area and further outfield
  grooming. The electrical box maintenance in the outfield was also another item that
  needed improvement. The ramp to the snack shed will be renovated by the League due
  to wear. A maintenance check list will be provided to Supervisor Morquecho by the end
  of the week. A Junior League agreement will also be developed in the future.

  8.  STAFF ITEMS

  A.  CITY COUNCIL MEETING COMMISSIONER ATTENDANCE SCHEDULE (VERBAL
  REPORT)

  Community Services Supervisor Morquecho provided a brief overview. CHAIR RETZ is
  available for January 14 but not the January 28. COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI will not
  be available January 14th. COMMISSIONER CIAROLLA is unavailable mid-March
  through the March 31. COMMISSIONER POPE is available January 28 and unavailable
  second Tuesdays.

  B.  JANUARY 2020 COMMISSION MEETING DATE (VERBAL REPORT)

  Due to Martin Luther King Jr holiday, the January meeting will be moved to Tuesday,
  January 21. COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA will not attend that date.

  9.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  EQUESTRIAN COMMITTEE ADJOURNED DRAFT MINUTES OF NOVEMBER 18, 2019

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF DECEMBER 10, 2019

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  10.  FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  A.  PROPOSED SUMMER MOVIE NIGHTS

  ACM Davis stated staff will return in January with movie options.

  B.  RACE AGREEMENT REVIEW

DRAFT PARK AND ATIVITIES MEETING MINUTES  5
DECEMBER 16, 2019
   Community Services Supervisor Morquecho stated that the City Attorney is currently
  reviewing the agreement and that a red line draft will be available in January.

  C.  GEORGE F CANYON OUTLOOK PROJECT

  Community Services Supervisor Morquecho stated that staff is researching how to
  incorporate a possible future Eagle Scout project for the outlook. Results on findings will
  come in the following weeks.

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI asked about the past presenter of automated lockers and
  the result of his contact with the City. ACM Manager Davis responded that no contact
  information was left to the City and that no follow up was done by the presenter.

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI also asked about the proposed mural at Highridge Park
  by a previous presenter, Mariana DeSalles. ACM Davis responded that the City was not
  successful in getting a response.

  CHAIR RETZ asked about the progress of the Nature Center remodeling project. ACM
  Davis responded that a City Council subcommittee was created to work with the architect
  firm on the scaling down of the project to lower costs. ACM Davis also added that staff
  was looking at gathering grants, Quimby Funds, Pepper Tree Foundation fund raising,
  and the City’s partnership with the Land Conservancy to fund this project.

  COMMISSIONER BAIN asked about the progress of Taber Grove. Community Services
  Supervisor Morquecho responded that Wildan Engineering is redesigning plans so that
  the drainage pipe construction will only take place on the Taber property.
  COMMISSIONER BAIN asked if the park idea was tabled. ACM Davis responded that it
  was tabled until Phase 1 of the project was completed. ACM Davis added that the
  neighborhood will also be notified about the process and that the Phase 2 portion of the
  project was not yet funded and would need approval by the Commission to be included.

  11.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR RETZ made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI to,

  ADJOURN THE MEETING AT 8:15 PM TO AN ADJOURNED PARK AND
  ACTIVITIES MEETING ON JANUARY 21, 2020 AT 7:00 P.M. IN THE CITY
  COUNCIL CHAMBER, 4045 PALOS VERDES DRIVE NORTH, ROLLING HILLS
  ESTATES.

  There being no objection, CHAIR RETZ so ordered.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  __________________________  _____________________________
  Daniel A-Haja  Cynthia Morquecho
  Community Services Coordinator  Community Services Supervisor
DRAFT PARK AND ATIVITIES MEETING MINUTES  6
